title: Trust-by-Design: Evaluating Issues and Perceptions within Clinical Passporting
reasoning: The paper's central theme is "Trust-by-Design," which involves a deep analysis of how to build trust into a digital identity system. It moves beyond purely technical considerations to incorporate and evaluate human values and ethical principles. The paper explicitly develops and validates design principles such as "Human welfare," "Non-maleficence," "Justice," "Trustworthiness," and "Dignity." The core of the research is about translating ethical concepts and values into a technical design framework, making it a work with a significant ethics component.
